import pandas as pd

# Load the datasets
time_series_df = pd.read_csv('/data/time_series_data.csv')
capital_df = pd.read_csv('/data/capital.csv')
pollen_df = pd.read_csv('/data/pollen_openness_score_Belau_Woserin_Feeser_et_al_2019.csv')

# Display the first few rows of each dataset
time_series_df.head(), capital_df.head(), pollen_df.head()

# Check the 'capital.csv' dataset for the relevant time period (1100-500 BCE)
capital_df[capital_df['BCE'].between(500, 1100, inclusive='both')]

# Check the 'pollen_openness_score_Belau_Woserin_Feeser_et_al_2019.csv' dataset for PC1 values in the relevant time period (1100-500 BCE)
pollen_df[pollen_df['CE'].between(-1100, -500, inclusive='both')]

# Extract the PC1 values for the beginning of the Younger Bronze Age (1100 BCE)
belau_pc1_1100_bce = pollen_df[pollen_df['CE'] == -1100]['Belau_PC1'].values[0]
woserin_pc1_1100_bce = pollen_df[pollen_df['CE'] == -1100]['Woserin_PC1'].values[0]

# Extract the PC1 values for the subsequent time horizons (1000 to 500 BCE)
belau_pc1_1000_to_500_bce = pollen_df[(pollen_df['CE'] >= -1000) & (pollen_df['CE'] <= -500)]['Belau_PC1'].values
woserin_pc1_1000_to_500_bce = pollen_df[(pollen_df['CE'] >= -1000) & (pollen_df['CE'] <= -500)]['Woserin_PC1'].values

belau_pc1_1100_bce, woserin_pc1_1100_bce, belau_pc1_1000_to_500_bce, woserin_pc1_1000_to_500_bce
